t: r/DeathStranding on Reddit: Can anyone here let me know if this website is legitimately owned by Kojima Productions?

s: 1 week ago - Kojima Productions Co., Ltd. is a Japanese video game development and film production studio founded in 2015 by Hideo Kojima, creator of the Metal Gear franchise. It is the spiritual successor to a production team inside Konami also known as Kojima Productions originally founded in 2005.
